_comments: The Forms submit outbox (#303). FormSubmissionEngine publishes one message here per FINAL
submit, inside the submit transaction (a DatabaseProviderBase publish enlists in the caller's
transaction), so the response and its 'run my automations' message commit together or not at
all. That replaces the detached promise that a killed process could lose.
Database transport: it is the one every host has, and it is what makes the enlisted publish
possible. IsFifo false: automation runs for different responses are independent. External
publish is off: only the submit engine may announce a submission. The payload is three ids
(ResponseID, FormVersionID, FormDistributionID), far under the payload cap, and the response id

fields.Name: forms.response-submitted
fields.Description: MJ Forms: one message per final response submission, published in the submit transaction. Payload { ResponseID, FormVersionID, FormDistributionID }; DeduplicationKey is the response id.
